mission_result: Implemented a role-fluid universal worker allocator CLI/library that reuses the landed worker kernel for prepared/derived-ready selection, adds evidence-ranked append-only stale recovery, scoped context/compact fallbacks, authorized deduplicated discovery, and proof-gated idle behavior.

test_receipt.truth_boundary: Tests were executed locally against a behavior-compatible harness for the landed kernel API; repository code imports the actual scripts/universal-cognitive-worker-lib.mjs. No repository CI run was observed at publication time, so this is candidate test evidence rather than production proof.

design_delta: Reused kernel allocateRoleAndOpportunity instead of duplicating queue/claim/capability/authority/write-collision logic.
Converted eligible stale attempts into scored RECOVER candidates whose claim mode is always APPEND_ONLY_RECOVERY_CLAIM.
Kept DISCOVER/CONTEXT_COMPILE/COMPACT as explicitly authorized fallbacks after prepared/recovery work is exhausted.
remaining_boundary: Independent integration/CI exercise and broad-wave evidence are still required before any production /w claim.
